description:
Groups the small language, error-reporting and runtime-contract gaps found while building the catalog and in the cold tests, none of which a target workload blocks on: constructs (defk-nii, defk-oit, defk-pe3, defk-3rl, defk-sbp), compile-error quality (defk-10d, defk-ajj, defk-xyz), internal consistency (defk-27w) and the stats contract across reloads (defk-9qv).

Rule from the map (defk-dtw): a construct enters the subset only when a workload needs it, it must be what an Elixir developer writes first, cost nothing over the hand loop, and keep Elixir's meaning with an Elixir-mode implementation and agreement tests. Every new construct or limit is documented in docs/language.md and, where a code is added, in the generated docs/compile-errors.md.

Done when: each child is closed, or closed as wontfix with the reason, and docs/language.md lists every limit the closed children left in place.

comments.text: Closed 2026-10-26: every child closed; defk-pe3 moved out by the owner (deferred). vcx.5 merged in PR #83 (d4e45c7d).

title: Kernel subset and devex gaps
